body:
Parameters: size (8-1024), background (none|square|circle|squircle), hue (0-360), tone (0-1), expression (idle|happy|sad|mad|surprised|wink|sleepy|smug|unsure|scared|love|shy|sick|thinking), title (≤128 chars), gen (1|2)
Each parameter is optional; defaults produce a deterministic avatar for the given name.
